source_notes: Oracle MyLearn publishes the 1Z0-811 objectives, format and pass mark, but no weights or past papers. Stage tests are original; output answer keys come from compiling and running the code. Objective 6.2 names %d, %n and %s as 'escape sequences'; they are format specifiers, so the lesson teaches both format specifiers and true escape sequences.
